//ConnectionStrings: UnoTP is the database, and must be set.
//Backend: The gateway the backend APIs are behind, unless a service's own section gives it a BaseUrl. Set the real host in the environment, never here.
//Services: One section per service below. BaseUrl is the service's own address, set in the environment when it is not behind the gateway; blank, it is called at Backend:BaseUrl. BasePath is its place under that address, and every other path is under that. No leading slash.
//AuthApi: The way in from the portal: decrypt what it sent, start the session, read the menus.
//PanApi: A holder's PAN checked with NSDL.
//UidMasking: An Aadhaar copy with its number masked, before it is filed.
//Ckyc: Whether CERSAI holds a KYC record for a PAN and date of birth.
//Idfy: Idfy.Api: document identification, OCR (a cheque's too), verification with the issuer, the PAN-Aadhaar link and face match.
//NameScreening: Whether a holder may invest online. ApiCall 0 switches it off. ApiKey is set in the environment, never here.
//NameMatch: Whether two names are the same person's.
//Shortener: The payment link shortened on submit. No ShortenPath, and the link goes in full.
//RateLimits: Tries allowed in a minute: the way in, by address; and one holder's document of one type, within one session and application - over it the page says so in a popup. 0 takes a limit off. RefusedWaitMinutes: how long a document waits, once refused the most times in a row the rules allow, before it may be tried again.
